History & Introduction
Started in the same year in which Indian Standards Institution was founded i.e.1947 in one room with handful of standards.
BIS Library is proudly stands as the largest library of standards in the South Asian region.
As Bureau of Indian standards is a national standard body of India, BIS Library also act as a national repository of standards, who serves government officials, scientists, researchers, consumers and the general public by providing up to date and relevant information on standards, codes, technical documents, research papers, historical & archived materials.
In essence, the BIS Library is not only a repository of knowledge but also a catalyst for informed decision-making and innovation. It ensures that vital information on standards is accessible to all, supporting progress and excellence across various fields.
